4: import numpy as np

6: from ._base import SelectorMixin
7: from ..utils import check_array
8: from ..utils.sparsefuncs import mean_variance_axis, min_max_axis
9: from ..utils.validation import check_is_fitted
10: 
11: 
12: class VarianceThreshold(SelectorMixin, BaseEstimator):
13:     """Feature selector that removes all low-variance features.
14: 
15:     This feature selection algorithm looks only at the features (X), not the
16:     desired outputs (y), and can thus be used for unsupervised learning.
17: 
18:     Read more in the :ref:`User Guide <variance_threshold>`.
19: 
20:     Parameters
21:     ----------
22:     threshold : float, optional
23:         Features with a training-set variance lower than this threshold will
24:         be removed. The default is to keep all features with non-zero variance,
25:         i.e. remove the features that have the same value in all samples.
26: 
27:     Attributes
28:     ----------
29:     variances_ : array, shape (n_features,)
30:         Variances of individual features.
31: 
32:     Examples
33:     --------
34:     The following dataset has integer features, two of which are the same
35:     in every sample. These are removed with the default setting for threshold::
36: 
37:         >>> X = [[0, 2, 0, 3], [0, 1, 4, 3], [0, 1, 1, 3]]
38:         >>> selector = VarianceThreshold()
39:         >>> selector.fit_transform(X)
40:         array([[2, 0],
41:                [1, 4],
42:                [1, 1]])
43:     """
44: 
45:     def __init__(self, threshold=0.):
46:         self.threshold = threshold
47: 
48:     def fit(self, X, y=None):
49:         """Learn empirical variances from X.
50: 
51:         Parameters
52:         ----------
53:         X : {array-like, sparse matrix}, shape (n_samples, n_features)
54:             Sample vectors from which to compute variances.
55: 
56:         y : any
57:             Ignored. This parameter exists only for compatibility with
58:             sklearn.pipeline.Pipeline.
59: 
60:         Returns
61:         -------
62:         self
63:         """
64:         X = check_array(X, ('csr', 'csc'), dtype=np.float64)
65: 
66:         if hasattr(X, "toarray"):   # sparse matrix
67:             _, self.variances_ = mean_variance_axis(X, axis=0)
68:             if self.threshold == 0:
69:                 mins, maxes = min_max_axis(X, axis=0)
70:                 peak_to_peaks = maxes - mins
71:         else:
72:             self.variances_ = np.var(X, axis=0)
73:             if self.threshold == 0:
74:                 peak_to_peaks = np.ptp(X, axis=0)
75: 
76:         if self.threshold == 0:
77:             # Use peak-to-peak to avoid numeric precision issues
78:             # for constant features
79:             self.variances_ = np.minimum(self.variances_, peak_to_peaks)
80: 
81:         if np.all(self.variances_ <= self.threshold):
82:             msg = "No feature in X meets the variance threshold {0:.5f}"
83:             if X.shape[0] == 1:
84:                 msg += " (X contains only one sample)"
85:             raise ValueError(msg.format(self.threshold))
86: 
87:         return self
88: 
89:     def _get_support_mask(self):
90:         check_is_fitted(self)
91: 
92:         return self.variances_ > self.threshold
